important_methodological_decisions: Community IDs are excluded because their numeric values are arbitrary labels, not ordered quantities.
R1-R7 modular-role labels are excluded because they are deterministic discretizations of within-module z and participation coefficient.
Exact total/decomposition redundancies are excluded from the ML whitelist; raw descriptive versions remain preserved in the upstream F2 outputs.
No biological annotation and no super_class label is present in the frozen topological feature table.
Suggested transformations are metadata only. All scaling, imputation or transformation must be fitted inside the training split/fold during ML.
